viral_posts.hook: My only regret with YouTube is that I didn’t start 10 years ago.⁠
viral_posts.caption:
My only regret with YouTube is that I didn’t start 10 years ago.⁠
⁠
Because long-form isn’t a post.⁠
⁠
It’s an asset.⁠
⁠
Short-form gets a little spike… then disappears down the toilet of the internet.⁠
⁠
Long-form sticks.⁠
⁠
People find it.⁠
⁠
People binge it.⁠
⁠
And here’s the magic:⁠
⁠
Binges are buyers.⁠
⁠
I used to think the goal was time on list.⁠
⁠
It’s not.⁠
⁠
It’s time on brand.⁠
⁠
How many minutes of your stuff can someone consume before they decide,⁠
“Yep. This is my person.”⁠
⁠
That’s the game.⁠
⁠
Follow for more.
